spec.notes: A man sitting on a bench in the park. The camera pushes in.

cast.name: Marcus
cast.line: a man in his 60s with a short grey beard, a navy wool peacoat, a grey flat cap, brown corduroy trousers and brown leather shoes

user_look: He sits alone on a weathered wooden park bench beside a gravel path in a city park in autumn, holding a paper coffee cup in both hands, elbows on his knees. The lawn between viewer and bench is real grass, a little long, scattered with yellow and rust plane-tree leaves, and a raked gravel path curves from the bottom of the frame toward the bench. Mature plane trees with mottled bark and full, irregular canopies of turning leaves stand to his left and right. Beyond the trees, at the far edge of the park, a row of brick townhouses. Clear morning sun from frame left, low in the sky, lights the lawn, the bench and the man, with long tree shadows across the grass toward frame right. Low autumn sun, dark bark, dry leaves, wool.
